title: Exact-SKU Recorded Physical Balance Aggregation
selectedSlice: A — pure exact-SKU recorded physical balance aggregation
purpose: Aggregate an explicitly supplied set of canonical FOOD-005Z production-batch recorded physical balance snapshots that all bind one exact SKU id/version, without claiming authoritative current quantity-on-hand.

input.sku: One exact SKU reference { id, version }.
input.batchBalances: Explicit array of canonical FOOD-005Z production-batch recorded physical balance snapshots.

output.recordedPackageBalance: Signed safe-integer aggregate over supplied exact-batch recorded balances.
output.batchReferences: Detached frozen deterministic exact production-batch references.

rules: The aggregation is pure and synchronous.
The caller supplies the evidence set explicitly.
An empty batch-balance set is valid and returns recordedPackageBalance zero.
Every supplied batch balance must be a strict canonical FOOD-005Z-shaped record.
Every supplied batch balance must bind the exact requested SKU id/version.
Each exact batch id/version may appear only once.
Duplicate exact batch identities are rejected even if payloads are identical.
Different versions of the same batch id are distinct exact batch identities and may coexist only if supplied as distinct canonical facts.
recordedPackageBalance is accumulated internally using BigInt.
The final aggregate must fit the signed JavaScript safe-integer range.
Negative aggregate recorded balances are valid and preserved.
batchReferences are sorted deterministically by batch id then version.
The result and all nested references/arrays are detached and frozen.
The aggregation does not enumerate production-batch persistence.
The aggregation does not enumerate inventory-movement persistence.
The aggregation does not establish evidence completeness or a consistent persistence cutoff.
The aggregation is not authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
The aggregation does not subtract reservations.
The aggregation does not calculate available-to-promise.
The aggregation does not write or claim stocked SKU capacity.
The aggregation does not create trusted inventory mutation authority.
The aggregation does not authenticate callers.
The aggregation does not infer fulfillment, handoff, sale or physical departure.
No migration change is required.
Migration 0003 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
Migration 0004 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
deferred: Persisted production-batch enumeration by exact SKU.
Persisted movement-history enumeration by exact batch.
